title: What is the difference between useEffect and useLayoutEffect?
description: Understand when to use each effect hook.

data.text: **Question:** What is the difference between useEffect and useLayoutEffect?

useEffect runs asynchronously after the browser paint, while useLayoutEffect runs synchronously after all DOM mutations but before the browser paint. Use useLayoutEffect for DOM measurements and useEffect for side effects.

**useEffect:**
- Runs asynchronously after render is committed to screen
- Does not block browser painting
- Suitable for data fetching, subscriptions, timers
- Can cause visual flicker if used for DOM measurements

**useLayoutEffect:**
- Runs synchronously after DOM mutations but before paint
- Blocks browser painting
- Suitable for DOM measurements and synchronous mutations
- Prevents visual flicker

data.title: useEffect vs useLayoutEffect

data.text: Interviewers want to assess understanding of React rendering lifecycle and when to use each effect hook.

items: What happens if you use useEffect for DOM measurements?

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Use useEffect for most side effects
data.takeaway: Default to useEffect. Use useLayoutEffect only when you need to measure or mutate DOM synchronously.
